name: Cheeseburger Skillet (Low-Carb)
ingredients_verbatim: 4 slices of bacon chopped into small pieces
1 pound ground beef or ground turkey
1/2 cup chopped onion about half of one small onion
why: Cheeseburger flavor with no bun/pasta/rice base - structurally low-carb (meat + bacon + cheese + cream cheese). Published 423 cal / 5.3g carbs / 25g protein clears the band; carbs are deep under ceiling. Distinct from catalog's cheeseburger-pasta and cheeseburger-rice-bowls. Weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly to 14. Sits near the 400 floor - flagging that our label-DB compute could land slightly lower; consider a higher-cal variant if the gate is tight.
